confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are central estimates from several aggregated Doha cost-of-living indexes (including Numbeo) and listed menu and guide prices, converted at the fixed riyal peg. Sources differ in age, and some are crowd-sourced or undated, so treat them as rough. Beer reflects licensed hotel and restaurant pricing. The mid-range figure sits near the median of sources, some of which may include tea or dessert, so it may run slightly high for no drinks. Cocktail and wine anchors rely on listed prices, not the beer ratio. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July low-season Doha market. No accommodation search, booking page or listing was checked, so they are the least certain values.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used as a base. Food and drink rest on Doha-specific listings, with Dubai comparison values used only as a sanity check. Accommodation is estimated from Doha's own hotel tiers with a July low-season adjustment.
